title: Cloud Security Engineer – SRE
description:
SRE (Security Engineer)
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Cloud Security Engineer – SRE to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in systems administration, cloud computing, and infrastructure as code, with a particular focus on solution engineering/site reliability. This role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance our security posture and streamline processes through automation.

Technical Skills
• Programming and Scripting: Strong proficiency in languages like Python, Go, Bash, or Ruby. SREs often need to write automation scripts and build tooling.
• Systems Administration: Deep understanding of operating systems (Linux/Unix), file systems, processes, and system configurations.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef to manage infrastructure.
• Cloud Computing: Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including services like EC2, S3, Kubernetes, and serverless functions.
• Containers and Orchestration: Expertise in containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift).

title: Editorial Lead
description:
Top Must Have's:
o Experience with long form, top line editing
o Ability to spot and shape great stories based on unclear business requests
o Act as a mentor to a team of writers, editors and analysts



JD: As Editorial Lead, you will lead the team responsible for shaping and delivering Cognizant's thought leadership agenda. You'll guide the creation of compelling, insight-rich content that strengthens Cognizant's voice in the market and positions us as a leader in technology services—often by writing about emerging technologies, including AI.

We're looking for a strategic editorial leader who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves and editing a research report, executive blog or web page, and helping a team of talented editors and writers navigate the challenges of a large, fast-moving organization to deliver top-quality content aligned with the business's goals. The ideal candidate will be an experienced B2B content marketer and creative problem-solver, able to influence senior stakeholders across the business; apply new technologies and approaches like AI in content creation; develop and leverage content in a variety of media channels, from web and social, to presentations, campaigns, events and advertisements—and measure its success.

This is a temp-to-perm leadership role reporting to the head of brand, creative strategy, content and thought leadership—who started at Cognizant as a consultant herself.

Leadership & Management
• Lead and manage a team of on-staff and contract editors and writers to develop high-impact thought leadership content in a variety of short- and long-form formats.
• Set and uphold editorial standards; define and continuously evolve what "good” looks like across different content types.
• Maintain and expand the firm's editorial strategy, ensuring it aligns with Cognizant's business goals and market positioning.
• Mentor and develop team members through coaching, feedback and hands-on guidance.
• Allocate resources effectively across projects and content streams to meet timelines and quality benchmarks.
• Analyze content performance and use those insights to refine the editorial strategy.
• Stay current on technology industry and content trends to ensure Cognizant's editorial approach remains forward-looking.
• Promote the editorial function to senior executives; act as a brand ambassador for Cognizant and Cognizant's thought leadership.
• Create space for innovation, repositioning legacy editorial programs and piloting new ones in response to evolving business needs.

Content Development & Editing
• Oversee the end-to-end editorial process—from ideation and research to outlining, ghostwriting, editing and production.
• Track technology news and Cognizant priorities to proactively develop content ideas.
• Guide internal and external writers in producing everything from a web page or infographic to a research report, blog, executive POV or client presentation.
• Take the lead on writing high-profile pieces when needed, including both short- and long-form content.
• Collaborate with research teams from hypothesis development to publication, helping shape narratives grounded in original data and insight.
• Partner with marketing, digital, and design teams to ensure effective distribution and audience engagement.
• Ensure all content is accurate, insightful, well-structured, and consistent with Cognizant's brand and compliance standards.
• Understand and apply digital metrics to inform content strategy and optimize performance across platforms.

Communication & Collaboration
• Serve as a trusted editorial advisor to subject-matter experts and business leaders across the organization.
• Continuously educate people across functions and organizational levels on thought leadership standards, personnel and processes.
• Use influence and empathy to uphold best practices in thought leadership—even under tight timelines.
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across research, communications, brand, digital, social and executive teams.
• Build relationships with external media outlets and industry publications to amplify Cognizant's voice.
• Advocate for editorial excellence in cross-functional settings, ensuring content supports broader business objectives.
• Help the team and firm adopt generative AI tools wisely; bring a thoughtful, ethical approach to using AI to scale and strengthen editorial work.

Qualifications
• 15+ years of experience in business-to-business writing, editing and content strategy, spanning long-form content such as research reports and short-form content, such as executive blogs, web pages, infographics and client presentations.
• Proven track record in partnering with research teams on original studies—from hypothesis framing to narrative development to final product.
• Prior experience leading editorial or thought leadership programs and managing teams of editors, writers and other contributors at a professional services, consulting or research-driven organization.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and navigate a complex, matrixed organization.
• Strong understanding of editorial and brand governance, and comfort operating in regulated or compliance-heavy environments.
• Hands-on experience with generative AI tools and a clear editorial philosophy around their integration.
• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or research background a plus.
• Personable, curious, adaptable—able to operate in ambiguity and unafraid to challenge assumptions in the service of better ideas and content.

applications.

Conduct experiments and analyze data to evaluate prompt effectiveness and optimize the 
overall prompt generation strategy.
